messages.subject: Re: meaning of the Estimate: ask
parts:
The estimates are the coefficients of the GLM model. In the case of
logistic regression, they are the log-odds ratios. To turn them into
odds-rations, just exponentiate them.

Example:
> exp(0.4457)
[1] 1.561583

Ian
